title: Editing Video by Chatting with AI

sections.heading: Everyday analogy
sections.body:
Think of traditional editing like cutting film by hand on a table. Prompt-based editing is like telling a helpful assistant what you want.

You say "remove silences and make me say this in Spanish with my own voice" and the assistant does the cuts. Your prompt is the typed instruction you give the AI.

sections.heading: Why it exists
sections.body:
These tools exist to skip timeline skills. Transcript-based editing lets you edit text to edit video, and text-to-video generation makes new clips from words.

Behind smart answers is RAG, which means Retrieval-Augmented Generation. The AI looks up real documents before it answers, so it is less likely to make things up. CUDA is the way programs run fast on NVIDIA graphics chips.

sections.heading: What can go wrong
sections.body:
What fails first if 100x more people clone avatars at once? The graphics chips run out and costs spike, and videos get fake-looking.

- AI avatar cloning can copy your face and voice without permission
- Auto-cuts can remove important pauses or words
- RAG can pull wrong documents and give confident wrong answers

steps.narration: You tell AI what to cut or create in plain words.
If needed, AI retrieves facts to answer correctly.
Work is accelerated on the GPU using CUDA.
You get back a finished video or avatar clone.

quiz.q: What does prompt-based video editing let you do?
options: Build a graphics chip by hand
quiz.why: Your saves show 13 tools that edit by chatting, transcript edits, and auto-cuts instead of manual timeline work.

quiz.q: What fails first if usage grows 100x for avatar cloning?
options: GPU capacity and cost, plus trust issues from fakes
quiz.why: More clones need more GPU power via CUDA, raising cost and wait times, and more fake avatars hurt trust.

quiz.q: What is RAG in simple terms?
options: AI looks up documents before answering
A way to turn off the internet
quiz.why: Your NVIDIA save lists RAG Model and RAG Agents to build smarter systems where LLMs meet retrieval.
